Detailed File Information
High resolution 40Ar/39Ar ages for the Gilberts Ridge: sample AVON2-1-7
File Name 03c0152.age
Data Type graphs, spreadsheet
Computer Program Microsoft Excel 2000
File Size 622.00 KB - 2 files [ age,xls ]
Expert Level Graduate School
Contributor Anthony A.P. Koppers
Source http://earthref.org/tools/ararcalc.htm
Description
Groundmass 40Ar/39Ar age for the small Niu guyot in the Gilberts Ridge seamount trail in the Southwest Pacific basin. Sample AVON2-1-7 is sampled at 3521-3861 m depth. This upload contains the ArArCALC v2.4 age calculation file and the same file in the Microsoft Excel 2000 format.
Geological Age Range and Timescale
70.8 Ma
Location
4º 27.54' N - 4º 59.09' N172º 11.60' E - 172º 49.84' E, Pacific Ocean, Gilberts Ridge, Niu Guyot, SMNT-047N-1725E, Southwest Pacific
Instructions
Two files are included in this ZIP archive. One is the *.AGE file that can only be opened in ArArCALC. The other is the same file but then saved in the Microsoft Excel format with the extension *.XLS and can be viewed outside ArArCALC. Note that the ArArCALC.log file is already included in the *.AGE file.
